site.name: Fra Mauro highlands
site.coordinate_note: Reported historical coordinates from the NASA mission summary; do not assume metre-accurate agreement with modern maps.

events.fact: A faulty abort-switch signal threatened to terminate descent. Ground specialists supplied a software workaround for the crew.
events.game_use: Historical basis for Scenario 1 warning and Mission Control dialogue

events.fact: Invalid landing-radar altitude and velocity information was recovered after the crew cycled the radar circuit breaker.
events.game_use: Historical basis for Scenario 2 radar warning and recovery

not_historical_measurements: The choice costs and resource percentages are gameplay values.
The backup height sensor is a fictional game capability unless separately documented.
Scenario 3 rock positions and branching outcomes are authored simulation content.
